text:
maya: morning async — quick check-in for model onboarding/evals

maya: what I did: pushed onboarding branch for openlm-13b-q4, ran full eval suite against `support-qa-v2` prompt set, started a small canary on dedicated cluster (10% traffic).

maya: blockers: seeing a small quality regression on qa f1 (~5 pts) vs the q3 baseline. not sure if it's prompt tokenization or quantization drift. logs + artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/run-1798123456/artifacts.tar.gz

owen: saw the eval summary — nice work getting canary up. can you paste the failing sample?

maya: sample from eval:```
Q: Who handles refunds?
Ref: Our billing team handles refunds within 30 days.
Pred: Please contact support and they will help you with a refund.
Metrics: f1 0.82 -> 0.77 (-0.05)
```

li: quick thought — `support-qa-v2` recently had a formatting change (curly quotes -> straight, extra trailing newline). tokenization mismatch can drop context. did we normalize?

maya: good call. I compared tokenizer lengths: baseline avg tokens=48, q4 avg tokens=52. looks like extra tokens creeping in.

sam: @maya @owen i've pushed a tiny normalization patch (PR #412) that strips smart quotes and trims trailing whitespace in prompt prep. can we run a smoke eval after applying?

maya: thanks @sam — running smoke now. kicking off: `./run_eval --suite support-qa-v2 --model openlm-13b-q4 --subset smoke`

ci-bot: Build started for PR #412 — tests queued (job 879). :gear:

maya: smoke results: f1 back to 0.80 (was 0.77), perplexity stable. still ~2-3 pts below q3 baseline.

owen: if normalization helps but doesn't fully close gap, maybe quantization profile differences are contributing. did you try q3 weights with the q4 runtime?

maya: not yet. i can run cross-check: q3 weights on q4 runtime and q4 weights on q3 runtime to isolate. estimate 30-45m each.

li: also check prompt templating: we added a `
` in a helper earlier — that added a blank line before user message for some flows. can cause extra prefix token.

maya: noted. gonna run two cross-checks and post artifacts. if both point to quantization, we may rollback canary or reduce to 5% until we have a fix.

sam: pinging @owen for review on PR #412 when you have a sec — low risk but would like a second pair of eyes. :eyes:

owen: will review in ~20. also let's add an auto-rollback rule to the canary: rollback if QA f1 drops >1.5% for 30m. we should be conservative.

maya: done — updated rollout config. also added an eval monitor check in console to alert on drift.

ci-bot: PR #412 tests passed — merging. :white_check_mark:

maya: merged, re-running full eval now. ETA ~45m. i'll post final numbers and recommend next steps (rollback vs continue).

li: thx. if you need a quick tokenization script i can paste one here.

maya: might take you up on that. thanks team. :thumbsup:

sam: fyi i stashed a small perf optimization for batcher that might reduce latency under canary load; will open a PR after we stabilize on quality.

maya: ok — wrapping for now. will update when full eval completes.
